Location: Located across from Connaught Park and close to Kitsilano Community Centre, this home puts green space, recreation, neighborhood cafés, shops and restaurants within easy reach. Enjoy nearby Broadway and West 4th Avenue, convenient transit connections and easy access to Kitsilano Beach.

Features: Enjoy park side living at 111–2688 Vine Street in the heart of Kitsilano. This bright, two-level end-unit townhouse offers approximately 1,478 sq. ft., three bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, with a spacious layout that makes everyday living and entertaining easy. The main floor features generous living and dining areas, a well-appointed kitchen and a convenient powder room. Upstairs, all three bedrooms are together, along with two full bathrooms and in-suite laundry.
A spacious wraparound terrace provides a welcoming outdoor retreat for morning coffee, relaxing or dining with friends. Two EV parking stalls add everyday convenience.
